[[Xiuquatl]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] scepter<ref>[https://massivelyop.com/2018/09/12/guild-wars-2s-next-living-world-episode-a-star-to-guide-us-launches-september-18-heres-the-trailer/ Guild Wars 2's next living world episode, A Star To Guide Us, launches September 18 – here's the trailer], Massivelyop.com</ref> crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]].

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|[[Hylek]] of the [[Astrozintli Forelands]] revere the life serpent Xiuquatl. While it's too small and gentle to be their savior, those traits make it [[Tequatl the Sunless|Tequatl's]] perfect opposite—and a potent symbol of hope.}}
{{quotation|[https://www.guildwars2.com/en/news/watch-the-trailer-for-a-star-to-guide-us/ Official website]|This mysterious obelisk houses a winged serpent familiar who will faithfully accompany you in battle.}}

== Graphics ==
Xiuquatl is an Aztec-themed scepter, imbued with the spirit of a snake deity. Upon drawing the weapon, the snake materializes next to the wielder of the scepter and follows them. A green aura surrounds the bearer of the weapon. While stowed, the scepter lies dormant and the winged serpent returns to the scepter as an Aztec carving.

;Aura
* A green mist covers the user of the scepter.

;Draw/Stow effects
* Upon drawing the weapon, the scepter erupts in green light. Broken shards of the top of the scepter circle it, and the snake materialises.
* When stowed, the snake dematerialises and the broken pieces repair themselves.

;Footfalls
* Misty green puddles appear on the ground and linger for a while.

;Skill effects
* Default projectiles are replaced with bits of green jade.
**{{g}} [[Guardian]]: [[Orb of Wrath]].
***{{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: [[Spear of Justice]].
**{{n}} [[Necromancer]]: [[Dhuumfire]], [[Dark Path]] and [[Life Blast]].
***{{harbinger}} [[Harbinger]]: [[Tainted Bolts]] and [[Dark Barrage]].
**{{e}} [[Elementalist]]: [[Dust Devil]], [[Fiery Frost]], [[Glacial Drift]],  [[Hurl]], [[Ice Shards]], [[Phoenix]], [[Stone Shards]], and [[Water Trident]].
***{{tempest}} [[Tempest]]: [[Overload Fire]]'s whirl finisher.
**{{m}} [[Mesmer]]: [[Ether Barrage]], [[Ether Blast]], [[Ether Bolt]], and [[Counterspell]].

== Trivia ==
* Xiuquatl was released with [[Living World Season 4]] Episode 4, [[A Star to Guide Us]].
* Xiuquatl may refer to the [[w:Nahuatl|Nahuatl]] words 'xiu' and 'coatl' which mean 'fire' and 'serpent' (or 'twin'), respectively.
* Xiuquatl may have been inspired by the Aztec deities [[w:Quetzalcoatl|Quetzalcoatl]] and [[w:Xiuhcoatl|Xiuhcoatl]], which mean 'feathered serpent' and 'turqoise/fire serpent', respectively, in the Nahuatl language.
